Intent and unlawfulness are explicitly supplied assessments; sources and descriptive chronology do not establish classifications. Route-local possession leaves repeat the same supplied throughout-interval proposition because requirements are trees. not_proved means technical non-satisfaction, without proved absence, lawfulness or innocence.

Competing supplied legal judgments. Neither request nor earlier-arrangement claim automatically settles unlawfulness. P leaves it open; E treats permission as ended; N does not establish unlawfulness and does not establish lawfulness.

documentSources.sourceText: 441. Whoever enters into or upon property in the possession of another with intent to commit an offence or to intimidate, insult or annoy any person in possession of such property, or having lawfully entered into or upon such property, unlawfully remains there with intent thereby to intimidate, insult or annoy any such person, or with intent to commit an offence, is said to commit “criminal trespass ”.

documentSources.sourceText:
Fictional analytical stipulations supplied by the exercise, not inferred from A-D.
Mina possessed the relevant property throughout the interval: proved.
Jun entered the property: proved. Jun's initial entry was lawful: proved.
Each relevant section 441 intention at the time of entry: not_proved.
Jun physically remained after 10:15: proved.
Jun intended to annoy Mina by remaining there: proved.
The other section 441 intention alternatives while remaining: not_proved.
Unlawfulness position P: unresolved(not_determined). The available material leaves the legal effect of the asserted earlier arrangement undetermined. This position does not settle whether Jun’s remaining was unlawful.
Unlawfulness position E: proved. This position treats Mina’s request as ending the relevant permission and does not treat the asserted earlier arrangement as establishing a continuing entitlement to remain.
Unlawfulness position N: not_proved. This position does not treat unlawfulness as established on the supplied material, given the unresolved earlier-arrangement claim. It does not positively establish that Jun’s remaining was lawful.
